items.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive

items.title: Kimi K3 Now Available via Telnyx Inference API
items.title_cn: Kimi K3现已通过Telnyx Inference API提供
items.summary: Moonshot AI released open weights for Kimi K3 today and it's live on Telnyx Inference. The architecture and Moonshot's own benchmarks are in their technical blog. This post is about running it on Telnyx. What we are adding: K3 is now available via the Telnyx Inference API, hosted on GPUs that we own and operate. This matters due to the size of this model. A 2.8T model needs dedicated infra to serve well. Because we own and operate the GPUs, we can contorl throughput. with no inter-provider hops
items.summary_cn: Moonshot AI今天发布了Kimi K3的开放权重，并在Telnyx Inference上直播。该架构和Moonshot自己的基准在他们的技术博客中。这篇文章是关于在Telnyx上运行它的。我们要添加的内容： K3现在可以通过Telnyx Inference API获得，该API托管在我们拥有和运营的GPU上。由于此模型的大小，这很重要。2.8T型号需要专用的基础设施才能很好地发挥作用。因为我们拥有和运营GPU ，所以我们可以控制吞吐量。没有提供商之间的跳跃
